import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data["entries"]

# Group files by directory, excluding skill/internal files for clarity

# Organize by directory
from collections import defaultdict
dirs = defaultdict(list)
for e in user_files:
    parts = e["path"].rsplit("/", 1)
    directory = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "/"
    dirs[directory].append({"name": e["name"], "size": e["size_bytes"], "is_dir": e["is_dir"]})

# Print organized listing
for directory in sorted(dirs.keys()):
    print(f"\n📁 {directory}/")
    for f in sorted(dirs[directory], key=lambda x: x["name"]):
        icon = "📂" if f["is_dir"] else "📄"
        print(f"   {icon} {f['name']}  ({f['size']} bytes)")
